page.overview:
Who is Katri?

Katri was a Mirialan Jedi Master and member of the Jedi Order's Jedi High Council. Between 50 BBY and 48 BBY, she was killed by a group of security guards on Raxus Secundus, and her death was investigated by Jedi Masters Mace Windu and Dooku. Her seat on the Jedi Council was awarded to Windu.
